canonicalization.serialization: JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, separators comma/colon without whitespace, ensure_ascii=false
canonicalization.hash_input: canonical_protocol only; wrapper and hash field excluded

prior_cycle.status: BLOCKED — HISTORICAL INDEX MEMBERSHIP NOT PUBLICLY PROVEN

hypothesis.name: SLOWER-TIMESCALE DIRECTIONAL PERSISTENCE
hypothesis.mechanism: Gradual information incorporation and institutionally split order flow may create short-lived continuation at slower intraday horizons.
hypothesis.falsification: Falsified for this cycle if no implementable preregistered formulation shows broadly positive Stage-A gross edge, or canonical Stage B fails pooled gross edge, either co-primary timeframe, withheld edge, breadth, economic, concentration, or chronological gates.

universe.name: traded STK/EQ selection-session universe
universe.definition: Every unique security in the official NSE FINAL bhavcopy for the mechanically frozen selection session with instrument_type=STK and series=EQ.
universe.limitation: Not all NSE equities and not every legally listed security; nontrading or suspended securities on that session are outside by definition.

chronology.freeze_point: Future separately authorized acquisition-readiness start, before new market-data acquisition
chronology.T_NEW: Latest authoritative NORMAL NSE cash-market session fully completed before that run's calendar date; immutable once resolved
chronology.window: 24 calendar months ending at T_NEW, resolved only with authoritative sessions
chronology.Stage_C: Final 6 calendar months ending at T_NEW
chronology.boundary_rule: First/last authoritative NORMAL sessions inside each calendar interval
chronology.selection_session: Last authoritative NORMAL session strictly before Stage A begins

legacy.instrument_type: STK only when authoritative legacy equity schema establishes it; otherwise unresolved

rules: map authoritative header names, never column positions
ISO date; exact base-10 decimal numeric parsing
TOTTRDVAL and TtlTrfVal have one canonical official traded-value semantic
no close-times-volume fallback in this cycle

history.unit: prior NORMAL trading-session observations before selection session
history.valid_observation: Official final-bhavcopy STK/EQ row resolving to same ISIN
history.listing: listing after window begins fails unless all 252 observations exist
history.symbol_change: join only with authoritative effective-dated continuity to same ISIN
history.corporate_action: unresolved identity or liquidity comparability fails closed

liquidity.window: Exactly 60 NORMAL sessions immediately before selection session
liquidity.measure: median canonical official daily traded value

eligibility: no material corporate-action ambiguity affecting identity/liquidity
selection: tie-break ISIN ascending then selection-session symbol ascending

diversification.later_point_in_time_sector_data: descriptive only absent a new preregistration before exposure

timeframes.residual: QC only; exclude from research; never pad/merge/fabricate
timeframes.CAS: exclude auxiliary rows per validated policy

contamination.pre_acquisition: compare all stages/identities to exposure registry
contamination.SBIN: If selected, retain in 24-cohort, split and logistics. Exclude overlapping exposed SBIN Stage B/C observations from pristine inference, bootstrap inputs, participation denominators and gates; do not replace. Only registry-proven non-overlap may be pristine.
contamination.other: same identity-date rule for every exposure

split.algorithm: digest=SHA256(UTF-8 phase26_protocol_sha256 + ':' + ISIN); sort digest ascending then ISIN ascending; first 16 visible, last 8 withheld
split.identity_visibility: allowed for logistics; withheld development price behavior inaccessible

roles.NEW_STAGE_B_SEALED: sealed until spec freeze and canonical authorization
roles.NEW_STAGE_C_SEALED: sealed until unchanged Stage B passes all gates

economics.trade_limit: portfolio-wide across all instruments and timeframes; each opened position counts once
economics.execution: next physical eligible bar/open under frozen implementation; no same-bar hindsight

primary.name: equal-condition, equal-instrument gross expectancy per trade in initial-risk units
primary.zero_trade: participation only; no artificial zero profitability

sample.change: none; compatible with 24 instruments and two co-primary conditions

concentration.denominator: zero/non-positive fails closed where governance requires

chronological.blocks: 3 predetermined contiguous blocks; session counts differ by at most one, remainder assigned earliest

governance.canonical: one authorized Stage B read/run; Stage C only after unchanged Stage B passes

stops: Stage A broad gross edge absent
